name: How long does an open floor plan remodeling project usually take?
description: Project duration depends on scope, especially if load-bearing walls are involved; simple projects take weeks, complex ones months.

mainEntity.name: How long does an open floor plan remodeling project usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for an open floor plan remodel varies significantly based on the project's scope, especially whether load-bearing walls are involved. A simple non-load-bearing wall removal might take a few weeks, while complex projects requiring structural modifications, permits, and extensive utility relocation can extend to several months. Understanding the structural implications early in the planning process can provide process clarity and a more accurate timeline.
